[explainBroadClimateDifferencesUsingGeographicFactors.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/atmosphereWeatherAndClimate/climatePatterns/skills/explainBroadClimateDifferencesUsingGeographicFactors.data.ts)

### Çevre ve cemiyet

Groups: 2 · Skills: 6

[environmentAndSociety.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/environmentAndSociety/environmentAndSociety.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Natural resources, environmental constraints and human decisions influence one another across space. Geography examines rates of resource renewal, adaptation to local conditions, transformations of land and the travel of impacts between connected regions.

[humanEnvironmentInteractions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/environmentAndSociety/humanEnvironmentInteractions/humanEnvironmentInteractions.data.ts)

These influences are reciprocal but not necessarily symmetric; different choices can reduce or intensify impacts.

#### Tabiiy resurslar

Skills: 2

[naturalResources.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/environmentAndSociety/naturalResources/naturalResources.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A natural resource is a material, stock or flow valued for human use, and availability depends on formation, replenishment, accessibility and demand. Geographic classifications should not equate renewable with inexhaustible or any deposit with a commercially recoverable resource.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Tabiiy maddeler ve süreçler insanlar içün niçün qıymetli resurslar olğanını ögren.

[explainReplenishmentAndDepletionOfNaturalResources.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/environmentAndSociety/naturalResources/skills/explainReplenishmentAndDepletionOfNaturalResources.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate regeneration, formation or supply rates to rates of human use: sunlight is a continuing energy flow, managed forests can regrow, while fossil fuels and many mineral deposits form far too slowly to replace extraction on human timescales. Renewable does not mean inexhaustible.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Yañıdan tola bilgen resurslarnı teşekkülinden tez tükenip bitkenlerinen ayır.

##### Bir şeyni tabiiy resurs etken şartlarnı añlatmaq

[explainWhatMakesSomethingANaturalResource.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/environmentAndSociety/naturalResources/skills/explainWhatMakesSomethingANaturalResource.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify when a natural material, living stock or environmental flow is usable to satisfy a human need, distinguishing the resource itself from a manufactured product and recognizing that usefulness can change with available technology or circumstances.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Tabiiy madde ya da çevre aqımı insan ihtiyaclarnı ne zaman qarşılaya bilgenini añlat.

Groups: 2 · Skills: 6

**Methodological description (English):** Geographic investigation turns observations about places into reasoned evidence, maps, comparisons and decisions. It includes asking spatial questions, collecting and scrutinizing data, evaluating alternatives and communicating conclusions rather than memorizing a particular set of locations.

### Coğrafiy obyektler

Groups: 4 · Skills: 20

[geographicObjects.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/geographicObjects/geographicObjects.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The world contains natural and human-made places and features with recognizable form, position and geographic roles. Learners classify these objects, interpret the conventional division of Earth into continents, parts of the world, oceans and hemispheres, and locate both familiar and global features. Processes that create or change these features belong to the relevant physical and human geography Domains.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Tabiiy ve insanlar yaratqan coğrafiy obyektlerni, Yerni bölme usullarını tanı.

[globalGeographicDivisions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/geographicObjects/globalGeographicDivisions/globalGeographicDivisions.data.ts)

### Geologiya

Groups: 6 · Skills: 28

[geology.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/geology/geology.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Minerals and rocks, Earth's internal structure, tectonic activity, geological evidence and mineral deposits reveal the solid planet's origins and evolution through deep time. Its focus is recognizing materials, processes and spatial evidence, distinct from describing everyday terrain or individual surface features.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Qayalar ve minerallar Yer küresiniñ qurulışı, tarihı ve tabiiy zenginlikleri aqqında nelerni añlatqanını ögren.

**Methodological description (English):** Sudden slip on faults and the movement of magma produce recognizable geological events with uneven spatial occurrence. This group addresses causes, observable landforms and spatial exposure; it does not prescribe individual emergency procedures or detailed physical equations.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Yer titrevleri ve vulkan faaliyeti çeşit bölgelerge nasıl şekil bergenini ögren.

**Methodological description (English):** Earth has internal layers with different composition and mechanical properties, while its outer lithospheric plates move across a geologically active planet. Plate interactions explain large-scale patterns of faults, relief and geological activity, not every small local feature.

##### Qaya ile mineralnı ayırmaq

[distinguishARockFromAMineral.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/geology/rocksAndTheRockCycle/skills/distinguishARockFromAMineral.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize that a rock may consist of one or more minerals, mineral fragments or other geological material, whereas a mineral is an individual crystalline substance with characteristic properties.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Qaya ile onıñ içindeki minerallarnıñ farqını añla.

##### Magmatik qayalarnıñ peyda olmasını añlatmaq

[explainTheFormationOfIgneousRocks.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/geology/rocksAndTheRockCycle/skills/explainTheFormationOfIgneousRocks.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate cooling and solidification of magma or lava to the formation of new rocks and differences such as coarse versus fine crystal textures.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Lav ya da magma suvup magmatik qayalarnı nasıl peyda etkenini añlat.

##### Metamorfik qayalarnıñ peyda olmasını añlatmaq

[explainTheFormationOfMetamorphicRocks.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/geology/rocksAndTheRockCycle/skills/explainTheFormationOfMetamorphicRocks.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe how heat, pressure and fluids can alter existing solid rock without it first melting into magma, producing new textures or minerals.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Issilik ve basım qattı qayanı tam eritmesten nasıl deñiştirgenini añlat.

##### Çöküntü qayalarnıñ peyda olmasını añlatmaq

[explainTheFormationOfSedimentaryRocks.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/geology/rocksAndTheRockCycle/skills/explainTheFormationOfSedimentaryRocks.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Trace deposited particles through burial, compaction and cementation into sedimentary material, distinguishing lithification from simple accumulation of loose sand.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Çöküntülerniñ sıqışuv ve çimentolanuv ile qattı qayağa nasıl aylanganını ögren.

##### Qaya devrinde deñişme yolunı izlemek

[traceAPathwayThroughTheRockCycle.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/geology/rocksAndTheRockCycle/skills/traceAPathwayThroughTheRockCycle.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Construct a plausible multi-stage change from one rock type to another using weathering, deposition, melting, cooling or metamorphism as applicable; different starting points need not follow one circular order.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Qaya çeşitleri arasında birden artıq mümkin deñişme yolunı izley.

### İnsan coğrafiyası

Groups: 4 · Skills: 17

[humanGeography.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/humanGeography/humanGeography.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Settlement, mobility, culture, political territories, livelihoods and economic connections create spatial patterns across inhabited places. The focus is geographic distribution, diffusion, regional relationships and the effects of place, not national political history or business accounting.

**User-friendly description (qm):** İnsanlar, yerleşimler, medeniyetler ve iqtisadiy faaliyetler yerlerde nasıl dağılıp yerleşkenini ögren.

#### Medeniy coğrafiya

Skills: 4

[culturalGeography.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/humanGeography/culturalGeography/culturalGeography.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Languages, practices, built environments and cultural identities form geographic distributions that evolve through human movement and interaction. Geographic interpretation describes spatial patterns and diffusion without assigning one culture to all inhabitants of a territory.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Medeniy adetler, tiller ve manzaralarnıñ türlü yerlerde nasıl farqlı olğanını ögren.

##### Türlü yerlerniñ medeniy manzaralarını teñeştirmek

[compareCulturalLandscapesAcrossPlaces.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/humanGeography/culturalGeography/skills/compareCulturalLandscapesAcrossPlaces.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate observable built forms, land use and place meanings to distinctive regional histories and practices, while avoiding stereotypes and one-to-one cultural labels.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Yerli çeşitlilik ve tarihke ürmetnen medeniy manzaralarnı teñeştir.

##### Medeniy adetlerniñ coğrafiy yayılışını añlatmaq

[explainGeographicDiffusionOfCulturalPractices.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/humanGeography/culturalGeography/skills/explainGeographicDiffusionOfCulturalPractices.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Trace how cultural ideas or practices may spread between places through migration, exchange and communication, without treating their spatial spread as automatic or uniform.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Medeniy adetlerniñ köçüv, alış-veriş ve haberleşme yolu ile nasıl yayılğanını añlat.

##### Medeniy hususiyetlerniñ coğrafiy dağılımını añlamaq

[interpretTheGeographicDistributionOfCulturalCharacteristics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/humanGeography/culturalGeography/skills/interpretTheGeographicDistributionOfCulturalCharacteristics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use spatial evidence to compare where linguistic, architectural or other cultural practices occur while recognizing overlap, diversity and the limitations of classifications.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Bir yerdeki episi insanlarnı bir türlü saymadan haritadaki medeniy hususiyetlerni teñeştir.

##### Medeniy manzarada insan tesirini tanımaq

[recognizeHumanInfluencesOnACulturalLandscape.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/humanGeography/culturalGeography/skills/recognizeHumanInfluencesOnACulturalLandscape.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify visible patterns such as farmland, places of worship, or historic streets without assuming all communities share one culture.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Bir yeriniñ medeniy manzarasında körüngen insan tesirini tanı.

#### İqtisadiy coğrafiya

Skills: 5

[economicGeography.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/humanGeography/economicGeography/economicGeography.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Production, services, resources, settlement demand and transport networks are unevenly distributed and connect places. Geographic specialization and cross-regional dependence describe spatial relationships rather than prices or financial accounting.

**User-friendly description (qm):** İqtisadiy faaliyetler qayda olğanını ve yerlerniñ nakliyat ile nasıl bağlanğanını ögren.

##### Faaliyet yerini belgilegen esas coğrafiy sebeplerni añlatmaq

[explainBasicGeographicFactorsAffectingActivityLocation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/humanGeography/economicGeography/skills/explainBasicGeographicFactorsAffectingActivityLocation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate transport access, resources, population, and environmental constraints to plausible site choices without claiming one universal optimal location.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Ulaşım qolaylığı, resurslar ve relyef işletmelerniñ qayda yerleşkenine nasıl tesir etkenini añlat.

##### Bölgeler arasında coğrafiy qarşılıqlı bağlılıqnı añlatmaq

[explainGeographicInterdependenceBetweenRegions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/humanGeography/economicGeography/skills/explainGeographicInterdependenceBetweenRegions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe how exchange of goods, services and resources links different regions so that changes in supply, transport or demand in one place can affect others.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Bölgeler mal, hızmet ve resurslar içün bir-birine nasıl bağlı olğanını añlat.

##### İqtisadiy faaliyetlerniñ coğrafiy ihtisaslaşuvını añlatmaq

[explainGeographicSpecializationOfEconomicActivities.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/humanGeography/economicGeography/skills/explainGeographicSpecializationOfEconomicActivities.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect differences in resources, climate, expertise, access and infrastructure to the concentration of particular types of production or services in different places, without assuming economic specialization is permanent.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Türlü bölgeler niçün ayrı iqtisadiy faaliyetlerge köprek diqqat ayırğanını ögren.

##### Yerleşim ya da bölgede topraq qullanımını tanımaq

[identifyLandUsePatternsInASettlementOrRegion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/humanGeography/economicGeography/skills/identifyLandUsePatternsInASettlementOrRegion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish residential, agricultural, industrial, and service areas by their spatial functions rather than building appearance alone.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Evler, ziraat, sanayi ya da hızmetler içün qullanılğan yerlerni tanı.

##### Mallarnıñ ya da insanlarnıñ ağ boyunca areketini izlemek

[traceMovementOfGoodsOrPeopleThroughANetwork.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/humanGeography/economicGeography/skills/traceMovementOfGoodsOrPeopleThroughANetwork.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Follow origin, intermediate links, and destination while recognizing the constraints of routes and transfer points.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Mallar ya da insanlar bağlı yollar ve almaştırma noqtaları boyunca nasıl yurgenini izle.

#### Siyasiy topraqlar

Skills: 3

[politicalTerritories.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/humanGeography/politicalTerritories/politicalTerritories.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Jurisdictions organize places using legally and socially defined boundaries that may change over time or be disputed. Political borders may follow rivers or mountains, but they are not the same kind of object as those natural features; cultural-landscape interpretation is covered separately in Cultural Geography.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Siyasiy sıñırlar ve idariy bölgeler coğrafiy fezanı nasıl bölgenini ögren.

##### Tabiiy hususiyetlerni siyasiy sıñırlardan ayırmaq

[distinguishPhysicalFeaturesFromPoliticalBoundaries.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/humanGeography/politicalTerritories/skills/distinguishPhysicalFeaturesFromPoliticalBoundaries.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize that a river or mountain is a land feature, while a state boundary is a social and legal line that may follow such a feature.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Tabiiy özen ya da dağ ile siyasiy sıñır arasında farqnı tanı.

##### Türlü derecedeki idariy topraqlarnı añlamaq

[interpretAdministrativeTerritoriesAtDifferentLevels.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/humanGeography/politicalTerritories/skills/interpretAdministrativeTerritoriesAtDifferentLevels.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate a municipality or region to a country without equating nested administrative units with continents or biomes.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Belediyeler ve bölgeler büyük idariy birliklerge nasıl kirgenini tanı.

##### Haritada memleketlerniñ yerini tapmaq

[locateCountriesOnAMap.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/humanGeography/politicalTerritories/skills/locateCountriesOnAMap.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify the positions of named sovereign states using a political map and stated time/context, recognizing that boundaries, names and political recognition may be disputed or change. Which countries are studied belongs to the Program, not the Skill identity.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Sıñırlar ve siyasiy tanınuv deñişe bilgenini esapqa alıp, memleketlerni tap.

#### Eali ve yerleşimler

Skills: 5

[populationAndSettlement.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/humanGeography/populationAndSettlement/populationAndSettlement.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Population counts, density, migration, and settlement forms show how human presence is unevenly distributed. The same total population can occupy very different spatial patterns.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Eali ve yerleşimler bölgelerde niçün bir türlü dağılıp yerleşmegenini ögren.

##### Köçüvni yerler arasında areket olaraq tasvir etmek

[describeMigrationAsMovementBetweenPlaces.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/humanGeography/populationAndSettlement/skills/describeMigrationAsMovementBetweenPlaces.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify origin, destination, and movement direction while distinguishing a migration flow from a static population count.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Köçüvni başlanğıç yerinden barılğan yerge qadar izlep añlat.

##### Köçüvniñ coğrafiy sebeplerini añlatmaq

[explainGeographicDriversOfMigration.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/humanGeography/populationAndSettlement/skills/explainGeographicDriversOfMigration.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect migration patterns with geographic differences in livelihoods, safety, climate, conflict or access to services, distinguishing plausible push and pull conditions from assumptions about any individual's motives.

**User-friendly description (qm):** İnsanlar bölgeler arasında niçün köçebilegeniniñ coğrafiy sebeplerini ögren.

##### Yerleşim dağılımını belgilegen coğrafiy sebeplerni añlatmaq

[explainGeographicFactorsShapingSettlementPatterns.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/humanGeography/populationAndSettlement/skills/explainGeographicFactorsShapingSettlementPatterns.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate available water, terrain, transport access, economic activities and other geographic constraints to clustered, linear or dispersed settlements; simple recognition of clustering belongs to the general Spatial Relationships competency.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Suv, relyef ve ulaşım qolaylığı insanlar qayda yerleşkenine nasıl tesir etkenini añlat.

##### Şeerleşüvni coğrafiy deñişme olaraq añlatmaq

[explainUrbanizationAsGeographicChange.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/humanGeography/populationAndSettlement/skills/explainUrbanizationAsGeographicChange.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe how the relative concentration of population and activity in urban areas can grow and reshape settlement networks, land use and infrastructure, without treating all urban growth as the same process.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Şeer ealisiniñ artuvı topraq qullanımını ve yerleşimlerni nasıl deñiştire bilgenini añla.

##### Eali sıqlığı haritasını añlamaq

[interpretAPopulationDensityMap.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/humanGeography/populationAndSettlement/skills/interpretAPopulationDensityMap.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish people per unit area from the total number of residents and identify areas with different densities.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Eali sıqlığı haritasında belgili alanda qaç insan yaşağanını oqu.

### Yer şekilleri ve yer yüzündeki süreçler

Groups: 3 · Skills: 11

[landformsAndSurfaceProcesses.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/landformsAndSurfaceProcesses/landformsAndSurfaceProcesses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relief and unconsolidated surface materials form landscapes that change through weathering, transportation and deposition. This domain examines the recognizable forms and near-surface changes of terrain rather than the internal structure, mineralogy or deep-time evolution of solid Earth.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Manzaralarnıñ şekillerini ve yer yüzündeki maddelerniñ nasıl köçip deñişkenini araştır.

#### Yer relyefi ve yükseklik

Skills: 3

[reliefAndElevation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/landformsAndSurfaceProcesses/reliefAndElevation/reliefAndElevation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The shape and vertical variation of terrain distinguish plains, hills, mountains, valleys and plateaus. Understanding elevation and relief also supports interpretation of slopes and contour information; foundational identification of landform categories belongs to Geographic Objects.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Yükseklikni, yer relyefini ve yamaclarnı tarif etip añlamağa ögren.

##### Yükseklik sızıqları arasındaki mesafege köre yamac dikligini añlamaq

[interpretContourSpacingAsTerrainSteepness.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/landformsAndSurfaceProcesses/reliefAndElevation/skills/interpretContourSpacingAsTerrainSteepness.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Read closely spaced elevation contours as a steeper surface than widely spaced contours under the same interval.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Yükseklik sızıqları arasındaki mesafege baqıp dik ve yavaş eğimli yamaclarnı tanıñ.

##### Yükseklikni tik ölçü referansına nisbeten añlamaq

[interpretElevationRelativeToAVerticalReference.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/landformsAndSurfaceProcesses/reliefAndElevation/skills/interpretElevationRelativeToAVerticalReference.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine or interpret a position's height relative to an agreed vertical reference such as mean sea level, taking account of map or observation units rather than confusing it with nearby height differences.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Bir yerniñ yüksekligini deñiz seviyesi kibi berilgen referansqa nisbeten oqu.

##### Yerler arasındaki nisbiy yükseklik farqını añlamaq

[interpretRelativeReliefBetweenLocations.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/landformsAndSurfaceProcesses/reliefAndElevation/skills/interpretRelativeReliefBetweenLocations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine or explain the difference in elevation between local points independently of their absolute heights above sea level, using it to describe the vertical variation of a landscape.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Yaqın yerler arasındaki yükseklik farqını deñiz seviyesinden yüksekligine baqmadan qıyasla.

#### Topraqlar ve yer yüzündeki çöküntiler

Skills: 4

[soilsAndSurfaceSediments.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/landformsAndSurfaceProcesses/soilsAndSurfaceSediments/soilsAndSurfaceSediments.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Soil develops through alteration of parent material and accumulation of organic matter, while loose sediments vary in grain size and drainage. Their location and physical conditions influence water movement, vegetation and practical land use.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Topraqlarnıñ ve gevşek çöküntülerniñ nasıl peyda olıp, yerden faydalanmağa tesir etkenini ögren.

##### Gevşek çöküntülerni dane büyükligine köre sınıflaştırmaq

[classifyUnconsolidatedSedimentByGrainSize.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/landformsAndSurfaceProcesses/soilsAndSurfaceSediments/skills/classifyUnconsolidatedSedimentByGrainSize.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish coarser gravel and sand from finer silt and clay by relative particle size and observed texture, without treating soil categories as identical to rock types.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Daneleriniñ büyükligine köre çaqıl, qum, toz ve balçıqnı ayır.

##### Yer yüzünde topraq qatlamlarınıñ nasıl peyda olğanını añlatmaq

[explainHowASoilProfileDevelopsAtTheSurface.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/landformsAndSurfaceProcesses/soilsAndSurfaceSediments/skills/explainHowASoilProfileDevelopsAtTheSurface.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate weathered mineral particles, organic input, water and organisms to the gradual development of soil horizons above parent material. An exposed rock surface or loose gravel layer is not automatically a mature soil.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Mineral daneleri, organik maddeler, suv ve canlılar topraq qatlamlarını nasıl peyda etkenini añlat.

##### Yüzey maddelerinde suvnıñ siñme farqlarını añlatmaq

[explainInfiltrationDifferencesAmongSurfaceMaterials.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/landformsAndSurfaceProcesses/soilsAndSurfaceSediments/skills/explainInfiltrationDifferencesAmongSurfaceMaterials.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use grain size, pore connectivity, compaction and water saturation to explain why water infiltrates into different soil or sediment deposits at different rates. Avoid assuming large grains always guarantee drainage in every setting.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Suvnıñ çeşit topraqlarğa ya da çöküntü qatlamlarına neden farqlı tezlikte siñgenini añlat.

##### Topraq şaraitinden yerden faydalanmanıñ esas sıñırlarını añlamaq

[inferBasicLandUseConstraintsFromSoilConditions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/landformsAndSurfaceProcesses/soilsAndSurfaceSediments/skills/inferBasicLandUseConstraintsFromSoilConditions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate waterlogging, shallow soils, or steep slopes to limitations on cultivation or construction without predicting engineering safety from appearance alone.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Topraq şaraiti ve yamaclar ekin ekmege ya da qurulışqa nasıl sıñır qoyğanını tanıñ.

#### Yemirilme, eroziya ve çöküntü toplanması

Skills: 4

[weatheringErosionAndDeposition.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/landformsAndSurfaceProcesses/weatheringErosionAndDeposition/weatheringErosionAndDeposition.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Rocks and sediment change on the exposed surface as material breaks down in place, is carried by water, wind, ice or gravity, and comes to rest elsewhere. These processes can alter valleys, coasts and plains without being confused with deep tectonic deformation.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Qayalarnıñ nasıl parçalanğanını, maddelerniñ nasıl taşınğanını ve çöküntülerniñ nasıl toplanğanını ögren.

##### Taşınğan çöküntülerniñ toplanmasını añlatmaq

[explainDepositionOfTransportedSediment.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/landformsAndSurfaceProcesses/weatheringErosionAndDeposition/skills/explainDepositionOfTransportedSediment.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify how moving sediment accumulates when transporting conditions change, such as at a river mouth, on a floodplain or in a dune field.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Çöküntüler taşınğandan soñ qayda toplanğanını añlat.

##### Eroziyanıñ yer yüzündeki maddelerni nasıl taşığanını añlatmaq

[explainHowErosionTransportsSurfaceMaterial.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/landformsAndSurfaceProcesses/weatheringErosionAndDeposition/skills/explainHowErosionTransportsSurfaceMaterial.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Trace removal and movement of loose material by flowing water, wind, ice or gravity, distinguishing the transport process from weathering at its source.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Suv, yel, buz ve yer çekimi gevşek maddelerni nasıl alıp taşığanını tarif et.

##### Özen yer şekilleriniñ peyda olmasını añlatmaq

[explainTheFormationOfFluvialLandforms.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/landformsAndSurfaceProcesses/weatheringErosionAndDeposition/skills/explainTheFormationOfFluvialLandforms.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate changing river flow, sediment transport and deposition to recognizable landforms such as meanders, floodplains, terraces and deltas. This integrative competency concerns the resulting landscape features, not a second generic definition of erosion or deposition.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Özen aqımı ve çöküntü taşınmasını özen burulmaları, taşqın düzlükleri ve deltalar ile bağla.

##### Açıqta qalğan qayalarnıñ yemirilmesini añlatmaq

[explainWeatheringOfExposedRock.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/landformsAndSurfaceProcesses/weatheringErosionAndDeposition/skills/explainWeatheringOfExposedRock.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe the in-place breakdown or alteration of exposed rock by temperature changes, water, organisms or chemical action; this does not by itself mean that broken material has been transported.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Açıqta qalğan qaya taşınmadan öz yerinde nasıl parçalanğanını ya da deñişkenini añlat.

### Haritalar ve coğrafiy mekân tasvirleri

Groups: 5 · Skills: 16

[mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Geographic representations convey selected positions, attributes and relationships through maps, globes, sketches, coordinates, imagery and spatial data. Competence includes interpretation and purposeful creation while acknowledging selection, measurement, projection and source limitations.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Haritalar, globuslar ve mekâniy malümatlar Yerniñ hususiyetlerini ve aralarındaki bağlarnı nasıl kösterdiğini ögren.

#### Coğrafiy koordinatlar

Skills: 3

[geographicCoordinates.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/geographicCoordinates/geographicCoordinates.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The graticule provides a worldwide angular reference for positions. Latitude and longitude are distinct measurements whose ordered combination identifies a location.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Yerdeki yerlerni enlik ve boyluqnen tarif et.

##### Coğrafiy enlikni añlamaq

[interpretLatitude.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/geographicCoordinates/skills/interpretLatitude.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize the Equator as zero latitude and compare how far a point lies toward either pole.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Enlikni ekvatordan şimaliy ya da cenübiy yerleşüv olaraq oqu.

##### Coğrafiy boyluqnı añlamaq

[interpretLongitude.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/geographicCoordinates/skills/interpretLongitude.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use the reference meridian and longitude values to locate east–west positions without confusing them with latitude.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Boyluqnı dayanç meridianından şarqta ya da ğarbta yerleşüv olaraq oqu.

##### Enlik-boyluq çiftinden noqtanı tapmaq

[locateAPointFromALatitudeLongitudePair.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/geographicCoordinates/skills/locateAPointFromALatitudeLongitudePair.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use both coordinates in their proper order and hemispheres to identify a geographic position.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Doğru sırağa qoyulğan enlik ve boyluq çiftinen yerni tap.

#### Coğrafiy mekân tehnologiyaları

Skills: 3

[geospatialTechnologies.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/geospatialTechnologies/geospatialTechnologies.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Satellite and aerial imagery, positioning systems and geographic information systems provide different kinds of geographically referenced evidence. The focus is interpreting and using that evidence for geographic questions, not programming a software package or memorizing individual interface controls.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Sputnik suretleri, yer belgilev sistemaları ve mekâniy qatlamlar nasıl deliller bergenini ögren.

##### Mekâniy malümat qatlamlarınen coğrafiy bağlarnı talil etmek

[analyzeGeographicRelationshipsUsingSpatialDataLayers.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/geospatialTechnologies/skills/analyzeGeographicRelationshipsUsingSpatialDataLayers.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Combine separately mapped geographic properties to investigate co-occurrence, proximity or spatial variation, taking account of registration, resolution and the risk of mistaking correlation for causation. GIS is a possible tool rather than the definition of the Skill.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Mekâniy qatlamlarnı birleştirip tertiplerni ögren, lâkin bağlanışnı sebepniñ delili sayma.

##### Uzaqtan sezme suretlerini añlamaq

[interpretRemoteSensingImagery.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/geospatialTechnologies/skills/interpretRemoteSensingImagery.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use spatial patterns, scale, source limitations and visible characteristics in aerial or satellite observations to infer geographic features and land-cover change. Comparing two dated images is one application of this competence.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Coğrafiy obyektlerni ve deñişüvlerni ögrenmek içün ava ya da sputnik suretlerini añlat.

##### Coğrafiy yön tapmaq içün sputnik yer belgilev malümatını qullanmaq

[useSatellitePositioningInformationForGeographicOrientation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/geospatialTechnologies/skills/useSatellitePositioningInformationForGeographicOrientation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret a position supplied by a GNSS device in relation to a coordinate reference and the surrounding geography; recognize that positioning has uncertainty and does not directly describe what is at the location.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Sputnik köstergen yerni qullan, lâkin hata olabilgenini de esapqa al.

#### Globuslar, haritalar ve proyeksiyalar

Skills: 3

[globesMapsAndProjection.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/globesMapsAndProjection/globesMapsAndProjection.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A spherical Earth cannot be shown on a flat sheet without some distortion, and different representations support different questions. Choosing one is a reasoning decision rather than a display preference.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Haritalar ve globuslar Yerniñ egri yüzüni nasıl farqlı köstergenini ögren.

##### Yerniñ modelleri olaraq globusnen yassı haritanı farqlamaq

[distinguishAGlobeFromAFlatMapAsEarthModels.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/globesMapsAndProjection/skills/distinguishAGlobeFromAFlatMapAsEarthModels.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why a globe represents the overall shape of Earth more directly while a flat map is easier to use for selected areas or purposes.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Globusnıñ yassı haritadan daa doğrudan neni köstergenini añlat.

##### Proyeksiyada meydan ya da şekil bozulmasını tanımaq

[recognizeProjectionDistortionInAreaOrShape.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/globesMapsAndProjection/skills/recognizeProjectionDistortionInAreaOrShape.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify that apparent sizes and shapes can change when the curved surface is flattened, especially when comparing distant latitudes.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Yerniñ yüzüni yassılaştırmaq közüngen ölçü ve şekillerni nasıl deñiştirgenini añla.

##### Maqsatqa uygun coğrafiy tasvirni saylamaq

[selectAGeographicRepresentationForAPurpose.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/globesMapsAndProjection/skills/selectAGeographicRepresentationForAPurpose.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Choose a globe, world or regional map, or detailed street plan according to the required spatial extent, scale and projection properties. This concerns the _representation and coverage_; choosing the subject matter of a political, geological or population map is a separate Skill.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Coğrafiy maqsatıña köre globus, büyük yer haritası ya da tafsilâtlı plan sayla.

#### Harita tasarımı ve şartlı belgiler

Skills: 4

[mapDesignAndConventions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapDesignAndConventions/mapDesignAndConventions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Creating and interpreting maps requires deliberate choices of symbols, legends, orientation, scale and labels. Conventions allow readers to infer geographic meaning from an authored representation without treating a map as a literal replica of the ground.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Belgiler, izahat, miqyas ve yön haritanı nasıl añlaşılır yapqanını ögren.

##### Haritalar yaratmaq

[createMaps.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapDesignAndConventions/skills/createMaps.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Select an appropriate spatial extent and represent places or geographically referenced information with consistent symbols, orientation, labels and scale as needed for a communication purpose. Sketching a classroom plan and constructing a thematic map are applications, not automatically distinct Skills.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Uygun belgiler, yazılar, yön ve miqyasnen añlaşılır harita yarat.

##### Haritanıñ yönüni şimaliy belgisine köre tapmaq

[determineMapOrientationFromItsNorthIndicator.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapDesignAndConventions/skills/determineMapOrientationFromItsNorthIndicator.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use the map's stated orientation rather than assuming the top of every depiction is geographic north.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Şimaliy er zaman yuqarda dep sanmayıp haritanı şimaliy belgisine köre yönelt.

##### Harita miqyasını mesafeler nisbeti olaraq añlamaq

[interpretAMapScaleAsADistanceRelationship.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapDesignAndConventions/skills/interpretAMapScaleAsADistanceRelationship.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize that a short mark on paper or screen represents a larger distance on the ground and that the ratio changes with scale.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Haritadaki mesafeniñ yerdeki mesafenen bağını añlat.

##### Harita belgilerini izahatına köre añlamaq

[interpretConventionalMapSymbolsThroughALegend.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapDesignAndConventions/skills/interpretConventionalMapSymbolsThroughALegend.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect a symbol or color to its documented meaning instead of assuming that its appearance is self-explanatory.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Harita izahatından belgiler ve renklerniñ manasını tap.

#### Harita çeşitleri ve mevzulu qatlamlar

Skills: 3

[mapTypesAndThematicLayers.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapTypesAndThematicLayers/mapTypesAndThematicLayers.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Maps may emphasize general reference features, political territories, physical relief, topography or specific themes such as geology, population, climate, weather, transport and resources. Categories overlap: for example, a geological or population map is thematic, and many maps combine layers. Choosing the relevant content is distinct from choosing a globe or map scale.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Çeşitli haritalarnıñ sıñırlar, yer şekilleri, ava ve insanlarnı nasıl köstergenini ögren.

##### Harita çeşitlerini malümatına köre tanımaq

[identifyCommonMapTypesByTheirInformationContent.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapTypesAndThematicLayers/skills/identifyCommonMapTypesByTheirInformationContent.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize whether a map presents political boundaries, physical relief, topographic detail, geological units, climate, population, resources or transport, using its title, legend and depicted variables. Explain that reference and thematic are broad roles, not mutually exclusive lists of named maps.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Haritanıñ qanday coğrafiy malümat köstergenini belgile.

##### Mevzulu harita izahatını ve deger sınıflarını añlamaq

[interpretAThematicLegendAndItsValueClasses.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapTypesAndThematicLayers/skills/interpretAThematicLegendAndItsValueClasses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate mapped color ranges, symbol sizes, or categories to the underlying variable while respecting units and class boundaries.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Mevzulu izahatnen haritadaki çeşitler, aralıqlar ve degerlerni oqu.

##### Coğrafiy sual içün harita çeşidini saylamaq

[selectAMapTypeForAGeographicQuestion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapTypesAndThematicLayers/skills/selectAMapTypeForAGeographicQuestion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Match a question to the type of information a map must show: for example, use a geological map to investigate rock distribution or a population-density map to compare settlement concentration. Do not substitute a visually attractive map lacking the required variable.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Belli coğrafiy sual içün uygun harita çeşidini sayla.

### Tabiiy bölgeler ve biogeografiya

Groups: 3 · Skills: 10

[naturalRegionsAndBiogeography.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Natural conditions create geographic variation in ecosystems, biodiversity and habitat patterns on land and in water. This field describes where ecological regions occur, how their distributions vary and how landscape changes affect them; organism physiology and detailed food-web mechanisms belong primarily to Biology.

**User-friendly description (qm):** İqlim, relyef ve suvnıñ canlılarnıñ coğrafiy dağılımına nasıl tesir etkenini ögren.

#### Biomlar ve yaşayış muhitleri

Skills: 3

[biomesAndHabitats.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/biomesAndHabitats/biomesAndHabitats.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Broad vegetation and habitat patterns reflect environmental conditions while local ecosystems can be more varied than a single biome label suggests.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Dünyanıñ türlü yerlerinde niçün çeşit yaşayış muhitleri olğanını ögren.

##### Türlü coğrafiy yerlerde yaşayış muhiti şartlarını teñeştirmek

[compareHabitatConditionsBetweenGeographicLocations.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/biomesAndHabitats/skills/compareHabitatConditionsBetweenGeographicLocations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use temperature, moisture, altitude, and land cover to explain contrasts in living conditions for organisms.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Türlü yerlerde ayrı yaşayış muhitlerini meydanğa ketirgen şartlarnı teñeştir.

##### Başlıca qara biomlarınıñ dağılımını tanımaq

[identifyMajorTerrestrialBiomePatterns.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/biomesAndHabitats/skills/identifyMajorTerrestrialBiomePatterns.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Associate broad forest, grassland, desert, and tundra patterns with environmental conditions rather than treating them as isolated species lists.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Dünyada ormanlar, otluq alanlar, çöller ve tundranıñ qayda dağılıp yerleşkenini tanı.

##### Biomlar arasındaki keçiş bölgelerini tanımaq

[recognizeTransitionZonesBetweenBiomes.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/biomesAndHabitats/skills/recognizeTransitionZonesBetweenBiomes.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify that vegetation and environmental conditions may change gradually across boundaries rather than at a perfectly sharp line.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Biomlarnıñ sıñırları birden degil de asta-asta deñişe bilgenini añla.

#### Ekosistemalar

Skills: 4

[ecosystems.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/ecosystems/ecosystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Ecosystems develop under different physical conditions on land and in water, and can vary markedly in spatial extent and connectivity. Geography focuses on the distributions of terrestrial, marine and freshwater environments, their boundaries, fragmentation and regional relationships, rather than organism physiology.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Türlü ekosistemalar qayda olğanını ve manzaralar boyunca nasıl bağlı olğanını ögren.

##### Deñiz ve tatlı suv ekosistemalarını ayırmaq

[distinguishMarineAndFreshwaterEcosystems.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/ecosystems/skills/distinguishMarineAndFreshwaterEcosystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Differentiate aquatic ecosystems shaped by saline ocean or sea water from those associated with predominantly fresh rivers, lakes and wetlands. Use salinity, water movement and geographic connections to explain broad habitat differences; recognize estuaries and other brackish transitional environments instead of forcing every location into one of two categories.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Deñiz, tatlı suv ve ekisi arasında olğan az tuzlu suv muhitlerini ayır.

##### Yaşayış muhitleriniñ bölünmesini coğrafiy süreç olaraq añlatmaq

[explainHabitatFragmentationAsAGeographicProcess.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/ecosystems/skills/explainHabitatFragmentationAsAGeographicProcess.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate roads, land-cover change or other barriers to the separation of formerly connected habitat areas, recognizing that the ecological consequences depend on species and landscape context.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Yollar ya da topraq qullanımınıñ deñişmesi evelden bağlı olğan yaşayış muhitlerini nasıl böle bilgenini añlat.

##### Tabiiy yaşayış muhitleri arasındaki bağlarnı añlamaq

[interpretConnectivityBetweenNaturalHabitats.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/ecosystems/skills/interpretConnectivityBetweenNaturalHabitats.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess whether geographic corridors or barriers link habitat patches and enable movement across a landscape, without claiming that proximity automatically guarantees ecological connection.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Yaşayış muhiti parçaları arasında tabiiy keçiş yollarını ve mania'larnı tap.

##### Biolojik çeşitlilikniñ coğrafiy dağılımını añlamaq

[interpretGeographicPatternsOfBiodiversity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/ecosystems/skills/interpretGeographicPatternsOfBiodiversity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify broad differences in variety of living organisms across mapped regions and relate them cautiously to climate, habitat complexity, disturbance and observation coverage.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Körsetişlerdeki farqlarnı esapqa alıp, haritalar yardımınen bölgelerdeki biolojik çeşitlilikni teñeştir.

#### Çevre şartlarınıñ dereceli deñişüvi

Skills: 3

[environmentalGradients.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/environmentalGradients/environmentalGradients.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Natural conditions often vary systematically with elevation, latitude, and proximity to water. Such gradients help explain patterns without implying that every place at the same latitude is identical.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Enlik, yükseklik ve suvğa yaqınlıq boyunca tabiatnıñ nasıl deñişkenini ögren.

##### Enlik boyunca çevre şartlarınıñ umumiy farqlarını añlatmaq

[explainBroadEnvironmentalVariationWithLatitude.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/environmentalGradients/skills/explainBroadEnvironmentalVariationWithLatitude.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect differences in solar input and circulation to large-scale environmental belts while allowing local exceptions.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Enlikni küneş yarığı ve tabiiy şartlardaki büyük farqlarnen bağla.

##### Coğrafiy delillerni teñeştirip çevre deñişmelerini tanımaq

[identifyEnvironmentalShiftsFromComparativeGeographicEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/environmentalGradients/skills/identifyEnvironmentalShiftsFromComparativeGeographicEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use two dated distributions or observations to describe a change in habitat range, without automatically assigning a single cause.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Türlü tarihlerdeki haritalar ya da baqımlardan yaşayış muhitleriniñ deñişüvini kör.

##### Yükseklik boyunca tabiiy şartlarnıñ deñişüvini tanımaq

[recognizeAltitudinalChangesInNaturalConditions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/environmentalGradients/skills/recognizeAltitudinalChangesInNaturalConditions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe how cooler temperatures and vegetation zones can occur higher on mountains without assuming identical patterns everywhere.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Dağ yamaçlarında yuqarığa çıqqanda yaşayış muhitleri ve sıcaqlıq nasıl deñişkenini tanı.

### Mekânda yön tapuv

Groups: 4 · Skills: 16

[spatialOrientation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/spatialOrientation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Locating and orienting oneself requires a stable or relative reference, directions, remembered spatial relationships and awareness of changing spatial and temporal frames. These competencies concern where places are, how we navigate between them, and how their civil and solar times relate—not how maps are drawn.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Yerler, yönler, yollar ve vaqıt farqları yön tapmağa nasıl yardım etkenini ögren.

#### Yerleşüv ve dayanç noqtaları

Skills: 3

[locationAndReference.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/locationAndReference/locationAndReference.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Locations can be described relative to a chosen reference, identified using stable geographic or civic references, and situated within areas of different spatial extent. The identity of the reference must be explicit rather than assumed from the observer.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Yerlerni belli dayanç noqtalarını qullanıp tarif etmege ögren.

##### Yerni dayanç noqtasına nisbeten tarif etmek

[describeALocationRelativeToAReferencePoint.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/locationAndReference/skills/describeALocationRelativeToAReferencePoint.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Express where a place lies by referring to another identifiable object or location, such as 'east of the station' or 'next to the bridge'. The statement changes meaning when its reference point changes.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Bir şeyniñ tanılğan başqa yerge nisbeten qayda olğanını tarif et.

##### Yerni sabit dayançqa köre belgilemek

[identifyALocationUsingAnAbsoluteReference.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/locationAndReference/skills/identifyALocationUsingAnAbsoluteReference.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use a stable agreed identifier, such as a coordinate pair in a named system or an address within a specified jurisdiction, to locate a place independently of a movable observer. Interpreting latitude and longitude is a separate cartographic competency.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Adres ya da koordinatlar kibi sabit malümatnen yerni tap.

##### Yerni yerli, regional ve dünya miqyasında belgilemek

[identifyLocationAtLocalRegionalAndGlobalScales.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/locationAndReference/skills/identifyLocationAtLocalRegionalAndGlobalScales.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate the same place to nested areas such as a neighborhood, country, and world region without confusing a change of scale with physical movement.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Aynı yerni mahalle, region ve dünya miqyasında tap.

#### Yol tapuv ve zihniy haritalar

Skills: 4

[navigationAndMentalMaps.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/navigationAndMentalMaps/navigationAndMentalMaps.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Moving between places relies on orientation, directional instructions, and sequences of turns. The focus is spatial navigation, not the mathematical calculation of distance.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Yönler, belgili nişanlar ve hatırda qalğan mekân bağlarını qullanıp yol tapmağa ögren.

##### Sıralı ara noqtalardan yol tizmek

[constructARouteThroughOrderedWaypoints.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/navigationAndMentalMaps/skills/constructARouteThroughOrderedWaypoints.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Choose an intelligible sequence of landmarks and turns between two positions, checking that the instructions preserve connectivity.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Nişanlar ve buruluşlarnı doğru sırağa qoyıp kesilmegen yol planla.

##### Esas yönlernen yolda yön tapmaq

[useCardinalDirectionsToOrientARoute.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/navigationAndMentalMaps/skills/useCardinalDirectionsToOrientARoute.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Associate north, east, south, and west with actual movement or a stated orientation, even when the observer faces a different way.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Yolnen ketkende şimaliy, cenübiy, şarqiy ve ğarbiy yönlerni qullan.

##### Ara yönlernen doğrultulardan farqlanmaq

[useIntermediateDirectionsToDistinguishBearings.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/navigationAndMentalMaps/skills/useIntermediateDirectionsToDistinguishBearings.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Locate positions such as northeast between adjacent cardinal directions rather than treating the compass as only four separate choices.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Pusulada şimaliy-şarq ve cenübiy-ğarb kibi yönlerni tanı.

##### Mekânda yön tapmaq içün zihniy haritalarnı qullanmaq

[useMentalMapsForSpatialOrientation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/navigationAndMentalMaps/skills/useMentalMapsForSpatialOrientation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Represent remembered places and spatial relationships internally, and use that representation to reason about position or a route without consulting a physical map. Drawing a familiar route, revising it after a new observation and imagining landmarks are different exercises for the same transferable spatial ability.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Hatırıñda qalğan yerlerge esaslanıp qayda olğanıñnı ve başqa yerge nasıl baracağıñnı añla.

#### Mekâniy bağlar

Skills: 3

[spatialRelationships.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/spatialRelationships/spatialRelationships.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Places and features form patterns of nearness, containment, connection, concentration, and separation. These relationships matter even when the exact names of the locations change.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Yerlerniñ nasıl bağlana, ayrıla ya da belli tertipte yerleşe bilgenini añla.

##### Toplanğan ve tarqalğan yerleşüvni tarif etmek

[describeClusteredAndDispersedArrangements.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/spatialRelationships/skills/describeClusteredAndDispersedArrangements.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare objects gathered in a small area with objects spread across a larger one while considering the observation scale.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Obyektler bir yerde toplanğan ya da ayrı-ayrı tarqalğanını tarif et.

##### Yanaşılıqnen yaqınlıqnı farqlamaq

[distinguishAdjacencyFromProximity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/spatialRelationships/skills/distinguishAdjacencyFromProximity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Two territories may share a boundary without being close to the same external landmark; nearby places need not touch.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Bir-birine bitişken yerlernen tek yaqında olğan yerlerni farq et.

##### Yerler arasındaki manialar ve keçiş yollarını belgilemek

[identifyBarriersAndCorridorsBetweenPlaces.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/spatialRelationships/skills/identifyBarriersAndCorridorsBetweenPlaces.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how a mountain range, river crossing, valley, or road can restrict or enable movement between otherwise nearby locations.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Dağlar, vadiler, yollar ve keçitler yerler arasında seferge nasıl tesir etkenini añlat.

#### Vaqıt quşaqları

Skills: 6

[timeZones.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/timeZones/timeZones.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Earth's rotation gives different longitudes different solar timing, while societies coordinate clocks through geographically assigned civil time rules. The same place can be described by its solar time, legal time-zone assignment, UTC offset and calendar date; these are related but not interchangeable.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Yerniñ dönüvi ve yerli qa'ideler saatlarda kösterilgen vaqıtnı nasıl belgilegenini ögren.

##### Berilgen UTC farqına köre resmiy vaqıtnı hesaplamaq

[determineCivilTimeUsingASpecifiedUTCOffset.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/timeZones/skills/determineCivilTimeUsingASpecifiedUTCOffset.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Apply a stated positive or negative offset to a known UTC time for a particular date, including when the resulting local date moves to the previous or next day. Do not infer an offset from longitude alone.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Berilgen UTC vaqıtı ve farqından yerli saattı tap, tarih deñişüvini de esapqa al.

##### Resmiy saattaki mevsimlik deñişüvlerni añlatmaq

[explainSeasonalChangesToCivilClockTime.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/timeZones/skills/explainSeasonalChangesToCivilClockTime.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify that some jurisdictions change their legal UTC offsets seasonally while others do not, and that the applicable rule depends on place and date rather than a universal daylight-saving schedule.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Bazı yerlerde saatlarnıñ mevsimge köre ne içün deñiştirilgenini, başqalarında ise deñiştirilmegenini añla.

##### Yerli resmiy vaqıt añlamını añlatmaq

[explainTheConceptOfLocalCivilTime.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/timeZones/skills/explainTheConceptOfLocalCivilTime.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain that the legally observed clock time in a place depends on the jurisdiction and applicable time zone, and can differ from the Sun's position. Civil local time is not the same concept as local solar time, and different places can share one civil clock time.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Bir yerde qanunen belgilengen saatnen Küneşke esaslanğan vaqıtnı farq et.

##### Yerli küneş vaqıtınıñ boyluqqa köre niçün deñişkenini añlatmaq

[explainWhyLocalSolarTimeVariesWithLongitude.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/timeZones/skills/explainWhyLocalSolarTimeVariesWithLongitude.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect Earth's rotation with the apparent passage of the Sun across the sky: places at different longitudes reach solar noon at different moments. This geographic tendency is not a rule that political zone boundaries follow exact meridians.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Farqlı boyluqlarda küneş öğlesi ne içün ayrı vaqıtlarda kelgenini añlat.

##### Alendeki tarih deñiştirme sızığını keçkende tarih deñişüvini añlamaq

[interpretCalendarDateChangesAcrossTheInternationalDateLine.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/timeZones/skills/interpretCalendarDateChangesAcrossTheInternationalDateLine.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine why adjacent locations on opposite sides of the approximate Pacific date boundary can have different calendar dates, noting that its actual course follows regional civil-time choices rather than a perfectly straight meridian.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Dünya tarih sızığını keçkende taqvim tarihiniñ ne içün deñişe bilgenini añlat.

##### Coğrafiy haritada vaqıt quşaqlarını oqumaq

[interpretTimeZonesOnAGeographicMap.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/timeZones/skills/interpretTimeZonesOnAGeographicMap.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Locate places assigned to different civil time zones using a legend or UTC offsets; recognize that boundaries may follow political borders and that some regions use half-hour or quarter-hour offsets.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Haritada vaqıt quşaqlarınıñ sıñırlarını ve UTC farqlarını oqu.

### Suv sistemaları

Groups: 4 · Skills: 13

[waterSystems.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/waterSystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Water connects landscapes through drainage networks, oceans, atmosphere, and underground storage. Geographic questions center on where water moves and accumulates, how its distribution varies, and how water features shape places.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Yer küresiniñ suvı qayda saqlanğanını, nasıl areket etkenini ve yerlerni nasıl şekillendirgenini araştır.

#### Donğan ve yer astı suvları

Skills: 4

[frozenAndSubsurfaceWater.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/frozenAndSubsurfaceWater/frozenAndSubsurfaceWater.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Snow, ice and groundwater store freshwater for different durations and interact with landscapes and human supplies. Their accumulation and discharge vary with climate, geology and geography rather than being visible only in rivers.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Qar, buz ve yer astı suvları tatlı suvnı nasıl saqlap turğanını ögren.

##### Buzluqlarnıñ peyda oluvı ve areketini añlatmaq

[explainHowGlaciersFormAndMove.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/frozenAndSubsurfaceWater/skills/explainHowGlaciersFormAndMove.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate sustained snow accumulation and compaction to slowly flowing land ice, distinguishing glaciers from seasonal snow cover and floating sea ice.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Toplanğan qar yavaş-yavaş aqıp turğan buzluqqa nasıl aylanğanını añlat.

##### Buzluqlarnıñ yer şekillerini deñiştirüvini añlatmaq

[explainHowGlaciersReshapeTerrain.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/frozenAndSubsurfaceWater/skills/explainHowGlaciersReshapeTerrain.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize broad erosional and depositional outcomes of moving land ice, such as glacial valleys, moraines and transported sediment, without treating all U-shaped valleys as proof of one event.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Buzluqlar oyğan ya da artında qaldırğan yer şekillerini tanı.

##### Yer astı suv qatlamı añlamını añlatmaq

[explainTheConceptOfAGroundwaterAquifer.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/frozenAndSubsurfaceWater/skills/explainTheConceptOfAGroundwaterAquifer.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify a permeable geological layer or formation that can store and transmit useful groundwater, distinguishing an aquifer from an open underground lake.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Suv keçirgen qayalar yer astı suvnı nasıl saqlap ve keçirgenini añla.

##### Tatlı suv zahireleriniñ geografik farqlarını añlatmaq

[interpretGeographicVariationsInFreshwaterStorage.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/frozenAndSubsurfaceWater/skills/interpretGeographicVariationsInFreshwaterStorage.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare places in which ice, aquifers, lakes or rivers hold accessible freshwater, recognizing differences in replenishment, seasonal availability and extraction limits.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Buz, yer astı suv qatlamları, göller ve özenlerni bölgeler arasında suv zahiresi olaraq teñeştir.

#### Suv devriniñ bağları

Skills: 4

[hydrologicConnections.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/hydrologicConnections/hydrologicConnections.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Water changes location and state among the atmosphere, surface, living systems, and subsurface. This is a connected circulation model rather than a single linear loop.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Suvnıñ ava, topraq, canlılar ve yer astı zahireleri arasında nasıl dolaşqanını kör.

##### Bölgeler arasında suv imkânını teñeştirmek

[compareGeographicWaterAvailabilityAcrossRegions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/hydrologicConnections/skills/compareGeographicWaterAvailabilityAcrossRegions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate precipitation, storage, seasonal variation, and demand to differences in accessible fresh water, rather than equating wet weather with secure supply.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Çeşit bölgelerde bulunğan tatlı suvnı teñeştir.

##### Suvnıñ siñüvi ve yer astı suvnıñ toluvını añlatmaq

[explainInfiltrationAndGroundwaterRecharge.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/hydrologicConnections/skills/explainInfiltrationAndGroundwaterRecharge.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect water entering permeable soils and rock to subsurface flow and replenishment of groundwater storage, distinguishing a downward pathway from direct surface runoff.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Suv topraq ve qayalarğa kirip yer astı suvlarını nasıl toldurğanını añlat.

##### Yer üstü suv aqışını añlatmaq

[explainSurfaceRunoffAsAWaterPathway.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/hydrologicConnections/skills/explainSurfaceRunoffAsAWaterPathway.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe water moving across land toward lower terrain and drainage networks when rainfall or melt exceeds infiltration and storage, distinguishing the process from water already stored underground.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Artıq yağmur ya da irigen qar suvı yer üstünden nasıl aqqanını tarif et.

##### Suv devrini añlatmaq

[explainTheHydrologicCycle.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/hydrologicConnections/skills/explainTheHydrologicCycle.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe the movement and storage of water among atmosphere, surface, living systems, ice and subsurface through evaporation, condensation, precipitation and flow. The cycles are multiple interconnected paths, not one mandatory linear sequence.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Buvğa çevrilüv, yağanaqlar, toplanma ve aqış arasındaki bağnı añlat.

#### Deñiz ve yalığa bağlı adiseler

Skills: 3

[marineAndCoastalProcesses.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/marineAndCoastalProcesses/marineAndCoastalProcesses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Coastal and marine environments differ in exposure, enclosure, water movement, and relation to land. The emphasis is on geographic patterns and coastal form rather than detailed fluid dynamics.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Dalğalar, gelgitler ve deñiz aqıntıları yalılarğa ve okeanlarğa nasıl tesir etkenini araştır.

##### Yalı aşınuvı ve çökünti şekillerini tanımaq

[identifyCoastalErosionAndDepositionFeatures.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/marineAndCoastalProcesses/skills/identifyCoastalErosionAndDepositionFeatures.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate cliffs, beaches, spits, or deltas to material removal and accumulation in their coastal setting.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Aşınuv ve çöküntiler toplanması ile peyda olğan yalı şekillerini tanı.

##### Okean aqıntılarınıñ geografik tertibini añlatmaq

[interpretGeographicPatternsOfOceanCurrents.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/marineAndCoastalProcesses/skills/interpretGeographicPatternsOfOceanCurrents.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize major surface-current directions and geographic effects on coastal climate, transport and marine conditions, without confusing circulation with periodic tidal change.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Deñiz aqıntılarınıñ dağılışı ve yalı bölgelerine tesirini añlat.

##### Okean gelgitleriniñ geografik tertibini añlatmaq

[interpretGeographicPatternsOfOceanTides.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/marineAndCoastalProcesses/skills/interpretGeographicPatternsOfOceanTides.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify regional and temporal variations in tidal water levels and their implications for coastlines and navigation, distinguishing tidal cycles from persistent ocean currents.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Yalıda yer ve vaqıtqa köre gelgitler nasıl deñişkenini teñeştir.

#### Özenler ve suv toplanğan havzalar

Skills: 2

[riversAndDrainageBasins.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/riversAndDrainageBasins/riversAndDrainageBasins.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Flowing water links sources, tributaries and outlets into networks, while topography governs the surface catchment of a river. Describing different types of water bodies as objects belongs to Geographic Objects.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Aqıntılar ve özenler nasıl bir ağnı teşkil etkenini ögren.

##### Yer şekline köre suv havzasını belgilemek

[delineateADrainageBasinFromTerrain.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/riversAndDrainageBasins/skills/delineateADrainageBasinFromTerrain.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Infer the land area contributing runoff to an outlet using divides and slopes rather than administrative borders.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Suvı belli bir özen çıqışına aqıp kelgen topraqnı belgile.

##### Özen ağınıñ esas qısımlarını tanımaq

[identifyTheMainPartsOfARiverNetwork.data.ts](../../../learningApps/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/riversAndDrainageBasins/skills/identifyTheMainPartsOfARiverNetwork.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish source, tributary, confluence, channel, and mouth by their roles in connected flow.

**User-friendly description (qm):** Özenniñ başlanğıcını, qollarını, qoşuluv yerlerini, yatağını ve ağızını tanı.
